meta.name: parallel-feature-development
meta.description: Coordinate parallel feature development with file ownership strategies, conflict avoidance rules, and integration patterns for multi-agent implementation. Use this skill when decomposing a large feature into independent work streams, when two or more agents need to implement different layers of the same system simultaneously, when establishing file ownership to prevent merge conflicts in a shared codebase, when designing interface contracts so parallel implementers can build against each other's APIs before they are ready, or when deciding whether to use vertical slices versus horizontal layers for a full-stack feature.

copy.tagline: 把大型功能拆成小块，多团队同时开发互不干扰
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要多人同时开发一个功能的不同部分
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel development of large features without conflicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team develops different parts of a feature concurrently

howto.what: 此技能指导 Claude 把大型功能拆成多个独立工作流，为每个执行者分配专属文件以避免冲突，制定接口契约，并用垂直切片或水平层等模式整合各部分成果。
howto.when: 当你说要把大功能拆成多个独立工作流、让多个代理同时实现同一系统的不同层、或建立文件所有权以避免合并冲突时触发；也可用于设计接口契约等场景。

say.text: 帮我把这个大型功能拆成独立任务，并分配每个代理的文件所有权
say.note: Claude会按技能给出拆分方案和所有权边界。

say.text: 请设计接口契约，让两个代理可以并行对接API
say.note: Claude会生成契约文件并指定唯一负责人。

say.text: 用垂直切片还是水平层来拆分这个全栈功能？
say.note: Claude会比较两种模式并给出建议。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude decomposes large features into independent work streams, assigns exclusive file ownership, designs interface contracts, and integrates via vertical slices or horizontal layers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you split a feature into independent streams, have agents implement layers, or set file ownership to avoid conflicts; also for interface contracts.

say_en.text: Break this large feature into independent tasks and assign ownership per agent.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the skill's ownership strategies.

say_en.text: Design an API contract for parallel agents to build against.
say_en.note: Claude will create a contract file and designate one owner.

say_en.text: Use vertical slices or horizontal layers for this full-stack feature?
say_en.note: Claude will compare pros and cons and give a suggestion.
